description: This file defines the 'ProxyMethodDescription' class in the Orleans code generator project, which describes an invokable method on a proxy interface, including its metadata and code generation details.

classes.name: ProxyMethodDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a proxy method, including its type parameters, associated interface, and code generation details.

classes.name: ProxyMethodDescription.ConstructedGeneratedInvokableDescription
classes.description: A nested class providing detailed type syntax and member descriptions for generated invokable representations of the proxy method.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ProxyMethodDescription.

methods.name: GetObjectCreationExpression
methods.description: Returns the C# syntax node representing the creation of the proxy method's invokable object.
